Path traversal in the forms that actually indicate a vulnerability.

Encoded, which has no innocent reading:
  GET /download?f=%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd
  GET /download?f=..%2f..%2fid_rsa

Reaching a sensitive system path:
  path = "../../../../etc/passwd"
  cp = "..\\..\\windows\\system32\\cmd.exe"
  shutil.copy(src, "../../.ssh/authorized_keys")

Composed with input, which is the vulnerability shape:
  open(base_dir + "../" + user_file)
  target = f"{upload_dir}/../{filename}"
  include($_GET['page'] . '../config.php');
